scope: One current exact13 real native meal-analysis interruption and new-draft recovery case. No production or artifact change.

execution.input: One already-exposed meal photo; no label, description entry, carbohydrate entry or Save.

observations.busyBeforeLeaving: Analyze disabled and accessibility value Analysis in progress observed before one Back action.
observations.newDraft: Photo tab selected, no selected meal/label images, Analyze disabled; no Estimate, final Review or Save.
observations.renderedState: Home after window and fresh Photo draft with food 0/3, label 0/1,disabled Build.

sourceSupport: AddMealView cancels analysis and invalidates photo loading on disappearance; completion checks cancellation and runID before navigation. Review found no concrete source defect; native case verifies the bounded UI outcome.
limits: Busy UI does not prove model generation began or OS inference compute stopped.
No late Estimate in 20 seconds is a bounded observation, not every possible future schedule.
Completion may race with Back; a different failed Home gate would need evidence before a cancellation-defect claim.
No direct inspection of every hidden description/reference field, rendered loading animation, other error/cancel branch, physical device/offline or recognition accuracy.
No full-photo Save case is rerun here; its passing receipt stays separate.
privacy: Curated metadata/hashes only. Raw logs, hierarchies, images, device identifiers and private paths stay local.
preservationScope: MealMirror app and original media; standard XCTest runner setup is separate.
